The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 in the 'Task' worksheet returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical statistics. This indicates that the formulas injected into the workbook use undefined names or functions that Excel/openpyxl cannot resolve. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the statistical summary block (EXPECTED_STATS) is broken.
